shared_elements: schematic animal bodies with stick-like legs
repeated small figures set out in a row
justification: Both surfaces show schematic profile quadrupeds and isolated plain discs, and both distribute small repeated figures roughly in a row, but these are the most generic possibilities available to any figurative tradition. A is dominated by human figures with staffs, raised arms and a man standing on a large horned bovine enclosed by a huge loop, whereas B shows no humans at all but a strict register scheme of stacked animals, birds and a serpentine/plant form above a zigzag band — the specific subjects and their relationships do not correspond.
